instruction: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves. Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad. Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.

postconditions.condition: The hand washing operation has been performed.

observable_cues: confirmation that hands were washed with soap and water
limitations: appearance of wet or clean-looking hands in an after_step RGB frame does not prove the washing operation occurred

review_notes: Hand washing is a process-based requirement; RGB snapshots cannot verify the completion of the washing activity.

preconditions.condition: The gloves to be used are clean.

observable_cues: provenance or visual confirmation that gloves are unused/clean
limitations: cleanliness is a material state that cannot be determined by RGB appearance alone

postconditions.condition: Clean gloves are worn on both hands.

observable_cues: gloves covering the user's hands
limitations: occlusion may prevent seeing both hands

steps.step_description: Inspect the cut on the skin pad.

actions.instruction: Look at the cut on the skin pad and check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.
actions.original_text: Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

postconditions.condition: The user has performed a visual inspection of the cut on the skin pad.
postconditions.source_reference: Look at the cut on the skin pad.

observable_cues: confirmation that the user looked at the target
limitations: static RGB frames do not prove the cognitive act of looking

postconditions.condition: The cut is confirmed to be not red, not swollen, and not leaking.
postconditions.source_reference: Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

observable_cues: absence of red discoloration around the cut
absence of visible fluid or discharge
absence of raised/distended tissue around the cut
limitations: swelling is difficult to assess in 2D RGB frames; clinical clearance requires expert review

error_criteria.violation_condition: The cut on the skin pad is red, swollen, or leaking.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The cut on the skin pad is not red, swollen or leaking.
error_criteria.applicability_condition: The user is performing the inspection of the cut.
error_criteria.source_reference: Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

observable_cues: redness around the cut
fluid leaking from the cut
bulging or distended skin around the cut
limitations: lighting may cause false positives for redness; 2D view limits swelling detection

actions.instruction: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
actions.original_text: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.

postconditions.condition: The pad used is a non-stick pad.

observable_cues: confirmation of pad material type or packaging label
limitations: Material identity (non-stick) is not verifiable from RGB appearance.

postconditions.condition: The pad is placed over the whole cut on the skin pad.
postconditions.source_reference: over the whole cut on the skin pad

observable_cues: pad covering the entire visible cut area
limitations: Target/interface occlusion can make pad coverage inconclusive; 'whole' requires expert interpretation.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The pad does not cover the entire cut.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The pad covers the whole cut.
error_criteria.applicability_condition: A pad is placed on the skin pad.
error_criteria.source_reference: over the whole cut on the skin pad

observable_cues: visible portions of the cut not covered by the pad
limitations: Perspective and occlusion may hide parts of the cut.

review_notes: 'Whole' and 'non-stick' require interpretation or confirmation beyond simple detection.

steps.step_description: Dispose of materials and clean hands.

actions.instruction: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag.
actions.original_text: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

postconditions.condition: The pad wrapper is inside the zip bag.
postconditions.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

observable_cues: pad wrapper contained within the zip bag volume
limitations: Occlusion by the bag or other objects can make containment inconclusive.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The pad wrapper is left outside the zip bag.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The pad wrapper is fully contained within the zip bag.
error_criteria.applicability_condition: The user attempts to dispose of the pad wrapper.
error_criteria.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

observable_cues: pad wrapper visible outside the bag boundaries
limitations: Occlusion may mask the actual location of the wrapper.

observable_cues: mechanical seal engagement verified
limitations: Seal engagement is not verifiable from after-step RGB snapshots.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The zip bag is not sealed.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The zip bag is completely sealed.
error_criteria.applicability_condition: The pad wrapper has been placed in the zip bag.

observable_cues: visible gap in the zip seal
limitations: Visual appearance of the seal can be deceptive; requires human verification.

review_notes: The source text 'seal it' refers to the zip bag used in A5.

postconditions.condition: The user has performed the operation of removing their gloves.

observable_cues: physical removal of gloves from hands
limitations: after_step RGB snapshots do not capture the removal process
system lacks interaction history or video to verify the event occurred

postconditions.condition: The user's hands are bare and free of gloves.

observable_cues: bare hands visible without glove covering
limitations: image appearance alone cannot confirm if gloves were previously worn and removed without history
subject to occlusion of hands in the camera view

review_notes: A7_post1 focuses on the execution of the glove removal process.
A7_post2 verifies the resulting bare-hand state.

postconditions.condition: The user has performed the handwashing operation.

observable_cues: handwashing at a sink with water
limitations: after_step RGB images of the work surface do not confirm handwashing
washing typically occurs outside the field of view of the dressing area
visual appearance of hands as clean or wet is not definitive proof of washing

review_notes: Handwashing is a process-oriented requirement not verifiable by a final-frame snapshot of the dressing scene.

context_notes: The source uses 'it' to refer to both the zip bag and the cut; dependencies clarify scope.
review_notes: Dependencies between steps are removed to favor precise Action-level dependencies. The dependencies of A3 on A2 and A5 on A4 are suggested by source flow but not explicitly stated as physical requirements; they are noted as customary for review.
Constraint 'not red, swollen or leaking' is quoted exactly as a contiguous unit.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user put on clean gloves (A2) before washing their hands (A1).
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: The user washed their hands (A1) before putting on clean gloves (A2).

observable_cues: sequential completion of handwashing before donning gloves
limitations: Single snapshots cannot establish temporal ordering of handwashing and glove application.
No video or tracked history supplied.

procedure_error_criteria.source_reference: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves.
limitations: System lacks time-aligned video or interaction history logs.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user sealed the zip bag (A6) before placing the pad wrapper inside (A5).
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: The user placed the pad wrapper in the zip bag (A5) before sealing it (A6).

observable_cues: wrapper presence inside bag prior to sealing
limitations: Snapshot at sealing does not prove contents were placed immediately prior.
Bag occlusion may hide wrapper status.

procedure_error_criteria.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.
limitations: No continuous observation to confirm sequence inside step S4.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user took off their gloves (A7) before sealing the zip bag (A6).
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: The user sealed the zip bag (A6) before taking off their gloves (A7).

observable_cues: bag sealing occurs while gloves are still worn
limitations: After-step snapshots provide final states only, not the order of completion.
Sequence between A6 and A7 is not verifiable with current snapshot polling.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user washed their hands (A8) before removing their gloves (A7).
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: The user removed their gloves (A7) before washing their hands (A8).

observable_cues: glove removal occurs prior to final hand hygiene
limitations: Handwashing state cannot be visually distinguished from glove removal in static images.
System does not track hand state or hygiene completion timestamps.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: The user placed the non-stick pad (A4) before checking the cut for redness, swelling, or leaking (A3).
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: The user inspected the cut (A3) before placing the non-stick pad (A4).

observable_cues: inspection behavior documented prior to pad coverage
limitations: Once the pad is placed (A4), the inspection site (A3) is occluded.

procedure_error_criteria.source_reference: Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
limitations: No aligned gaze or inspection history to verify A3 happened before coverage.

procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: One or more required actions (A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8) were omitted.
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: All actions A1 through A8 were performed as instructed.

observable_cues: Confirmed completion record for every action ID
limitations: Periodic snapshots are insufficient to prove the performance of every required step.

procedure_error_criteria.source_reference: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves. Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad. Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.
limitations: Missing observations in the system are not proof of omission; human verification is mandatory.

verification_review_notes: Verification updates provided only for the requested actions A7 and A8.
Order and missing step criteria were not generated as include_procedure_error_criteria was false.
Order errors are derived from sequential imperatives ('then', 'and', 'Then') and graph dependencies.
System snapshot capabilities are insufficient for verifying process sequence or missing steps without human confirmation.
A3-A4 sequence is enforced as checking redness/swelling must occur before the site is covered by the pad.
